attention: fused (MLX steel SDPA). The RENDER default, and NOT what the L1/L2 gates run: those use the explicit fp32 path. Chosen because explicit materialises a [1, 32, T, T] fp32 score matrix, which is quadratic in the token count and does not fit at long or large shapes. Measured disagreement against explicit: 1.11e-04 on attn1, exactly zero on audio_attn1.
